newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka navy kills six rebels in clash - radio.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka navy kills six rebels in clash - radio.

text.p: Sri Lankan navy gunboats sank a Tamil Tiger vessel, killing six rebels in a clash off the northern Jaffna peninsula, state radio said on Tuesday.
The Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation said a navy seaman was also injured in the incident late on Monday.
The clash occurred four nautical miles north of Kovilan Point, about 320 kilometres (200 miles) from the capital Colombo.
A military spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
The Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam are fighting for an independent Tamil homeland in the north and east of this predominantly Sinhalese island.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died since the war broke out in 1983.
